metadata.title: Gale crater region / MOLA MEGDR
metadata.vertical_datum: planetary radius minus GMM3 (mgm1025) areoid, degree/order 50
metadata.projection: local equirectangular tangent approximation, R=3396000 m, cos(centre latitude) longitude correction; not navigation-grade
metadata.processing: Exact 65x65 crop, row-major north to south. Signed big-endian int16. No resampling, smoothing, hole filling or generated elevations. Display centres and normalizes xyz.
metadata.caveat: Grid spacing is not effective resolving power: source bins are median observations or interpolated where empty; equatorial track gaps can reach 12 km. Not HiRISE, not suitable for rover/footstep physics.
metadata.credit: NASA / MGS MOLA Science Team / Goddard Space Flight Center; NASA PDS Geosciences Node
